# Address waits

[`WaitOnAddress`](/docs/api/windows/synch#wait-on-address) and the calls that wake its waiters.

<h2 id="wait-on-address"><code>WaitOnAddress</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func WaitOnAddress(
    address: *opaque,
    compareAddress: *opaque,
    addressSize: uint64,
    milliseconds: uint32
) -> bool32
```

Waits for the value at an address to change.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/synchapi/nf-synchapi-waitonaddress](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/synchapi/nf-synchapi-waitonaddress)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Synch.rux#L16)

**Parameters**

| Name             | Type      | Description                                                                     |
| ---------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `address`        | `*opaque` | the value to wait on                                                            |
| `compareAddress` | `*opaque` | a copy of the value the caller last saw; the wait ends at once when they differ |
| `addressSize`    | `uint64`  | the value's size in bytes: 1, 2, 4 or 8                                         |
| `milliseconds`   | `uint32`  | how long to wait at most, or [`INFINITE`](/docs/api/windows/process#infinite)   |

**Returns**: non-zero after a wake, and zero on time-out or failure with the reason in [`GetLastError`](/docs/api/windows/errors#get-last-error)

<h2 id="wake-by-address-single"><code>WakeByAddressSingle</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func WakeByAddressSingle(address: *opaque)
```

Wakes one thread waiting on an address.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/synchapi/nf-synchapi-wakebyaddresssingle](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/synchapi/nf-synchapi-wakebyaddresssingle)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Synch.rux#L22)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type      | Description           |
| --------- | --------- | --------------------- |
| `address` | `*opaque` | the value it waits on |

<h2 id="wake-by-address-all"><code>WakeByAddressAll</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func WakeByAddressAll(address: *opaque)
```

Wakes every thread waiting on an address.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/synchapi/nf-synchapi-wakebyaddressall](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/synchapi/nf-synchapi-wakebyaddressall)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Synch.rux#L28)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type      | Description            |
| --------- | --------- | ---------------------- |
| `address` | `*opaque` | the value they wait on |
